subject: ADR-183: the stations chart the session -- ten of the lab's station charts held bar by bar and step by step to the shipped session through a port of the page's chart primitives
body: THE DRAWING, BOUND TO THE DATA. The lab's inline SESSION was bound to the shipped session file and the file to the engine; the charts were bound to nothing, and ten station svgs the task's first read-report has returned since ADR-140 were named by no expectation. tools/verify/_lab_charts.py (imported, not run) ports frame, barChart and lineChart (yMax, xTicks, step) with the reader's own rounding, and station_charts(session) walks the session as render() does. verify_eco 143 -> 165: the live page's station paths, tick labels, x ticks and mark counts held to the port fed from docs/ecology-lab-session.json (20 checks), the task holds exactly the ten charts under the reader's cap, and the task's boot literals are the port's numbers. page-ecology-lab-science 211 -> 263: per chart marks, longest, tick column and row, spans whole, at.0 -- every literal from the port, none from the page. A moved task literal fails the suite; a moved session value fails the page check and the task check together. ADR-182's inline port replaced by the module. No page was edited.
